consistencia_visual.estilo_maestro: Vertical 9:16, high-end stylized 3D cinematic animation, RTX ray tracing reflections, Unreal Engine 5.4 Lumen global illumination, Octane path tracer quality, rich tactile PBR textures, volumetric atmospheric fog, cinematic shallow depth of field, vivid dramatic lighting, masterpiece render, no photorealism, no uncanny valley, no flat surfaces
consistencia_visual.motor_render: Unreal Engine 5.4 Lumen / Octane Raytracer Style
